name: sram
title: SRAM macro (sky130)
description: A 1 KB SRAM from the sky130 PDK behind a registered read port: a hard macro placed in the floorplan and powered by the grid. sky130A or sky130B only.
teaches: Hard macros: a memory block placed by hand inside the core, its keep-out, its power hookup and the views it needs (Cells & macros, Arrange).
